item.title: Self-Hosted WebDAV Servers: Radicale vs WebDAV-Go vs Nextcloud WebDAV Comparison
item.description: WebDAV (Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning) extends HTTP to allow collaborative file management on remote servers. It enables users to create, edit, move, and delete files on a server as if they were local — the foundation for calendar sync (CalDAV), contact sync (CardDAV), and collaborative document editing.
